statements.statement: The claim is for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The patient's symptoms are documented under diagnosis code R42
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
